Description
 BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft — and in the success of the brands they serve.
 This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.
 The Opportunity 
 We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands — emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative — and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.
 You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow — to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.
 This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.
 What You'll Own
 Email & Retention Design 
 Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
 Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
 Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms
 Web Creative & CRO Support 
 Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
 Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses — not just personal taste
 Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs
 Social & Ad Creative 
 Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
 Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
 Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed
 Process & Quality 
 Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
 Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
 Present work with a clear rationale — why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA — to internal teams and, when needed, clients
 Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
 Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks — while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
 Who You Are
 Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:
 An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color — your portfolio speaks for itself
 Conversion-minded — you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
 Detail-obsessed — you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
 A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
 Excellent at managing your time — you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
 AI-curious and AI-capable — you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
 Adaptable — you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
 What Success Looks Like
 In your first 90 days:
 You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
 You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
 You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
 You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
 Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests
 Must-Have:
 2–4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
 A portfolio showing e-commerce work — ideally with context on goals and results
 Advanced proficiency in Figma
 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
 Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
 Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
 Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
 Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
 Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team
 Strong Differentiators:
 Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
 Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
 Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
 Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
 Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
 Agency background preferred
 This role is fully remote.
 Time Commitment and Availability
 Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
 Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST
 Compensation 
 $20–25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

We are looking for a Structural Engineer to provide technical leadership and support operations and sustaining engineering project delivery across Iron Ore Company of Canada operations.

Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Engineering at Brex 
 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.
 What you’ll do 
 This opportunity is on our Product Data Platform (PDP) team, which builds and operates the high-performance data, query, and search infrastructure that powers critical Brex product experiences, including AI-powered data products like our agentic reporting experience. PDP's mission is to make Brex customizable, scalable, and reliable for finance teams, and that requires deeply optimized, production-grade distributed systems.
 As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll shape the technical direction of the platform across multiple teams. Your mandate is to identify the highest-impact architectural problems across the data products group, including the cross-cutting ones that fall between teams, and drive them to resolution. You'll be accountable for the group's technical quality, move between long-horizon strategy and hands-on execution, and lead through influence rather than authority.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.
 As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 Responsibilities 
 Lead technical strategy for critical PDP initiatives, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery across multiple teams.
 Identify and resolve systemic performance, consistency, and scalability problems, including cross-team gaps no single team can own.
 Own architecture direction for query performance: query plans, execution paths, cost models, indexing strategies, and schema and access-pattern design.
 Design and evolve distributed systems with thoughtful tradeoffs around consistency, latency, caching, cost, and failure modes.
 Raise the technical bar across the group through design reviews and architecture decisions, and dive in hands-on where it matters most, including P95/P99 latency issues in production.
 Proactively identify scaling risks and reliability gaps, and turn findings into plans the group aligns behind.
 Mentor senior engineers and grow the next generation of technical leaders within PDP.
 Contribute directly on high-stakes initiatives and critical path decisions, primarily in the JVM ecosystem (Kotlin/Java).
 Requirements 
 8+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale, including as a technical leader on multi-team initiatives.
 Track record of leading architecture and delivery for large-scale distributed systems in a platform or infrastructure environment.
 Deep hands-on expertise with relational databases (Postgres or Aurora strongly preferred), including query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and real-world optimization.
 Ability to drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a defined charter.
 Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders and align teams without direct authority.
 Experience mentoring senior engineers.
 Bonus 
 Hands-on experience with OpenSearch / Elasticsearch or similar systems in production.
 Experience with streaming data platforms (Flink, Kafka) or semantic/analytics layers in production.
 Experience with multi-tenant or data-heavy platforms in regulated environments.
 Experience building platform foundations for AI or agentic product experiences.
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity.
 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

Pour soutenir nos activités, nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Technicien(ne) RMA junior qui souhaite développer ses compétences techniques au sein d’une équipe collaborative et contribuer à la qualité et à la fiabilité de nos produits.
Votre rôle: Relevant de l’équipe technique, vous participerez à l’analyse, au diagnostic, à la réparation et à la mise à l’essai de produits électroniques retournés dans le cadre du processus RMA ( Return Merchandise Authorization ).

 Utiliser des outils et des appareils de mesure pour identifier les défaillances et valider le fonctionnement des produits. 
 Examiner les composants, les cartes de circuits imprimés, les connecteurs, le câblage et les alimentations afin de repérer les anomalies. 
 Lire et suivre les schémas électriques, les dessins techniques, les instructions de travail et la documentation applicable. 
 Consigner avec précision les défaillances observées, les tests effectués, les réparations réalisées et les résultats obtenus. 
 Assurer le suivi des dossiers de réparation, des pièces et des actions à effectuer. 
 Vérifier la qualité des réparations avant de retourner les produits dans le processus de traitement. 
 Collaborer avec les équipes Qualité, Production, Ingénierie et Recherche et développement (R-D) lorsque nécessaire. 
 Respecter les procédures de travail, les consignes de sécurité et les exigences de qualité.

 Aborder les problèmes de manière logique et méthodique, en vérifiant les causes possibles avant de proposer une solution.

 Organiser vos tâches et assurer un suivi fiable des dossiers et des réparations. 
 Recevoir les commentaires de façon constructive, poser des questions et reconnaître lorsqu’un problème nécessite de l’aide. 
 Communiquer clairement vos observations, tant verbalement que par écrit. 
 Collaborer avec différentes équipes tout en travaillant de façon autonome sur les tâches confiées.

 Expérience ou intérêt pratique pour la réparation, l’assemblage, le dépannage ou la mise à l’essai d’appareils électroniques. 
 Connaissances de base des composants électroniques, des connecteurs, des alimentations et du câblage. 
 Capacité à suivre des schémas électriques, des dessins techniques et des instructions de travail. 
 Connaissance des pratiques d’essai sécuritaires et volonté de respecter les procédures établies.

 Expérience en RMA, en réparation électronique ou en essais de produits.

 Connaissance d’un système ERP ou d’un logiciel de gestion des demandes de service. 
 Bilinguisme français-anglais, avec une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais.

 Une collaboration multidisciplinaire : travaillez avec des collègues de différents secteurs techniques. 
 Une occasion de grandir : gagnez en autonomie et approfondissez votre expertise au fil des projets.

 Role mandate  
 Help shape and deliver practical AI-enabled solutions for Commercial and Corporate Banking. This role combines business consulting, structured problem solving, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on use of AI tools. The Business Consultant will identify high-value opportunities and, critically, break ambiguous and complex business problems into manageable workstreams, planned requirements, clear deliverables, owners, dependencies, and realistic timelines. The role supports initiatives from discovery through implementation and adoption.  
 This is not a traditional requirements-only role. The Business Consultant is expected to operate as both a consultant and a delivery coordinator, stepping into project-management responsibilities when needed to maintain momentum, alignment, and accountability. The successful candidate must be intellectually curious about AI, comfortable learning as the technology evolves, and able to turn new capabilities into responsible, measurable business outcomes within a regulated banking environment. 
 What you will do  
 Lead discovery with bankers, operations teams, product owners, risk partners, and technology teams to understand business objectives, pain points, workflows, decisions, data needs, and user experiences.  
 Take ownership of ambiguous or loosely defined business problems. Establish clarity by separating symptoms from root causes, defining the problem and desired outcome, testing assumptions, and breaking the work into manageable, sequenced requirements and deliverables.  
 Build practical workplans that identify activities, milestones, timelines, dependencies, decisions, owners, risks, and next steps, then actively manage progress against the plan.  
 Identify and assess AI, GenAI, intelligent automation, and decision-support opportunities based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, user impact, risk, and implementation effort.  
 Use AI tools directly to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis, process design, requirements development, communications, and other knowledge-work activities, while applying appropriate judgment and controls.  
 Translate business needs into clear target-state concepts, business requirements, process maps, user journeys, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sequenced roadmaps.  
 Develop concise executive-ready materials, including recommendations, decision papers, status updates, presentations, and business cases that clearly explain the problem, proposed approach, trade-offs, risks, and expected value.  
 Plan, coordinate, and facilitate working sessions, decision forums, and cross-functional discussions. Prepare agendas and materials, guide the discussion, document decisions, assign actions, and follow through to closure.  
 Act as a delivery coordinator or project manager when required by managing timelines, dependencies, risks, issues, stakeholder commitments, and status reporting to keep initiatives moving.  
 Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences and drive stakeholders toward clear decisions and accountable next steps.  
 Partner with delivery teams to refine scope, prioritize backlogs, resolve ambiguity, support solution design, and maintain alignment between business intent and delivered outcomes.  
 Coordinate business validation and UAT, including test scenarios, defect triage, stakeholder communication, readiness assessment, and sign-off.  
 Assess change impacts and support communications, training, adoption, and feedback loops so solutions are understood, trusted, and used.  
 Embed responsible AI, privacy, data, security, risk, compliance, and governance considerations throughout the initiative lifecycle.  
 Monitor the evolving AI landscape and proactively bring forward relevant capabilities, limitations, use cases, and implications for banking.  
 Non-negotiable requirements  
 Applied AI experience: You have personally used AI tools in a work, academic, entrepreneurial, or project setting. Examples may include Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot Studio, AI-enabled analytics or automation tools, or comparable platforms. You can explain what you used, the problem it addressed, your approach, the outcome, and the limitations or risks you encountered.  
 Genuine AI curiosity: You actively follow how AI is evolving, experiment with new capabilities, and can form a thoughtful view of where AI creates value and where human judgment and controls remain essential. Deep AI engineering experience is not required, but passive interest is not sufficient.  
 Exceptional communication: You communicate clearly, directly, and with good judgment in writing and verbally. You can simplify complex topics without losing meaning, tailor messages to executives, business partners, risk teams, and technologists, and facilitate productive conversations when views differ.  
 Structured problem solving and planning: You are logical, analytical, and highly effective in ambiguity. You can take an unclear business problem, determine what must be known and decided, and decompose it into manageable workstreams, planned requirements, milestones, dependencies, owners, and next steps. This capability is central to success in the role.  
 Delivery coordination: You can move fluidly between consulting, business analysis, facilitation, and light project management. You coordinate people and activities, manage timelines and dependencies, surface risks early, maintain action logs, and follow through until decisions and deliverables are complete.  
 Independent execution: You organize your work, manage competing priorities, follow through on commitments, and produce high-quality deliverables with limited direction while knowing when to escalate risks or seek input.  
 Required experience and capabilities  
 Typically 5–7 years of relevant experience and a post-secondary degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  
 Deep knowledge and technical proficiency developed through extensive education and business experience.  
 Progressive experience in business consulting, business analysis, product, transformation, strategy, process improvement, or a comparable role in a complex enterprise environment.  
 Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous business problems, creating structure, and translating them into manageable workstreams, planned requirements, prioritized deliverables, owners, dependencies, and timelines.

 Experience creating clear process maps, business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, roadmaps, executive presentations, and decision-oriented communications.  
 Ability to define a target-state vision and decompose it into incremental, prioritized capabilities that can be delivered and adopted.  
 Experience supporting implementation, testing, business validation, change readiness, and user adoption.

 Ambiguous business problems are rapidly converted into a shared problem definition and a manageable plan of sequenced requirements, deliverables, milestones, owners, dependencies, and decisions.

 The role continuously improves how the team applies AI to its own work and shares practical learnings with others.

 Founded by third-generation jeweller Noura Sakkijha, the brand was built on a simple idea: fine jewelry shouldn’t require a special occasion, and it should never come with guilt. It’s about celebrating yourself—your style, your life, your everyday.
 Mejuri meets customers where they are—online, in app, and through a growing global retail footprint of 58+ stores worldwide.  La personne au poste de direction adjointe de magasin a la responsabilité de soutenir la direction de magasin dans tous les aspects de ses opérations, y compris l'excellence du service à la clientèle, la croissance des profits et la création d'un environnement motivant afin de permettre à l'équipe du magasin d'atteindre les buts et objectifs de l'entreprise.

Vous jouerez un rôle important dans le développement d'un environnement de vente au détail profondément centré sur notre clientèle et vous établirez les fondements de notre culture de vente.  Améliorer la qualité de l'expérience client en magasin en communiquant et en formant le personnel sur les étapes de vente de Mejuri, et en développant des liens grâce à l'histoire de la marque Mejuri.

 Adopter une mentalité multicanale, en recherchant continuellement des occasions d'éliminer les obstacles à l'achat et les points de friction pour la clientèle. 
 Collaborer avec les équipes de marketing et de services en magasin pour concevoir des activités et des collaborations en magasin qui s'adressent à notre communauté et améliorent l'expérience de la clientèle. Organiser un événement par trimestre dans votre magasin. 
 Être la voix de notre clientèle, en veillant à ce que les idées et les possibilités d'améliorer la marque, les produits et les services soient communiquées au siège social de Mejuri. 
 Répondre rapidement aux plaintes des clients et les transmettre aux cadres supérieurs.

 Assister la direction de magasin dans l'encadrement et le développement d'une équipe performante et orientée vers le service. 
 Participer au processus de recrutement des membres clés de l'équipe de votre magasin. 
 Établir et promouvoir de solides relations collaboratives sur votre marché et avec le siège social. 
 Créer et participer aux processus d'accueil des nouveaux membres de l'équipe. 
 Soutenir les nouveaux membres de l'équipe au cours de leurs premières semaines d'intégration et de formation, en assurant un esprit d'équipe solide. 
 Contribuer à l'animation des réunions de formation. 
 Soutenir une culture de performance fondée sur la responsabilité, l'amélioration continue et la réalisation des objectifs. 
 Communiquer clairement les normes à respecter et démontrer les comportements souhaités. Montrer l'exemple!

 Développer les affaires par du profilage-client, de la recherche de nouveaux clients et du renforcement des relations durables et productives avec la clientèle.

 Établir et mettre en œuvre des changements pour améliorer les performances des produits lorsque possible. 
 Améliorer les performances de vente de l'équipe grâce à la rétroaction, au mentorat et à la formation. 
 Examiner les données relatives à la productivité de l'espace et prendre des mesures pour maximiser la productivité et les performances de vente. 
 Fournir des solutions pour remédier aux écarts de performance en matière de vente. 
 Veiller à ce que le personnel soit formé de façon à disposer de compétences expertes en matière de relations avec la clientèle, de techniques de communication améliorées, de connaissances avancées sur les produits et de compétences avancées en matière de vente. 
 Recueillir les idées de la clientèle et les communiquer au siège social.

 Aider à la gestion des demandes de congés des stylistes et à la planification des horaires. 
 Soutenir les initiatives clés en collaboration avec la direction de magasin.

 Respecter toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise. 
 Remplir toute la documentation nécessaire pour les pertes, examiner les raisons et prendre des mesures pour réduire les pertes si possible. 
 Gérer l'équipe pour préparer et effectuer les inventaires dans un délai raisonnable et de manière efficace.

 Gérer la sécurité du magasin, des produits et de l'équipe, en signalant tout problème au siège social. 
 Transmettre rapidement toute communication du siège social à l'équipe en magasin, afin de permettre la préparation de tout nouveau programme, événement ou initiative.

 Soutenir la collecte et l'analyse des données relatives au marchandisage et travailler en collaboration avec votre équipe de direction pour maximiser la rentabilité. 
 S'assurer que tous les éléments de marchandisage appropriés sont mis en place conformément aux directives. 
 Collaborer avec la direction de magasin et le siège social pour lancer de nouvelles initiatives de manière organisée et dans un délai raisonnable. 
 Informer les partenaires du siège social de toute lacune ou de tout besoin en matière de marchandisage et de stocks. 
 Se concentrer sur l'analyse des stocks; signaler, identifier et agir en cas d'inefficacité. 
 Suivre et gérer la performance des indicateurs clés de performance des stocks. 
 Informer le siège social de toute rétroaction interne (membres de l'équipe) et externe (clientèle).

 Sens des affaires : aptitude à utiliser la connaissance du milieu commercial interne et externe pour améliorer et stimuler les performances.

 Prioriser les résultats : capacité à prendre personnellement des mesures pour s'assurer que les objectifs mutuels et les objectifs de performance sont atteints dans les délais appropriés. 
 Prioriser la clientèle : capacité à identifier tout obstacle potentiel pouvant avoir un impact sur l'expérience client. 
 Établir des relations : échanger des informations pour atteindre des objectifs mutuellement bénéfiques; gagner le respect et l'engagement des membres de l'équipe et maintenir actives les relations internes et externes de manière proactive.

 What's the opportunity? 
 We're looking for a driven problem-solver with AI fluency and business acumen who can partner with senior business stakeholders to identify and develop high-impact AI transformation opportunities. As a Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own a sub-segment within a Line of Business or Function — driving opportunity identification, solution concept development, and program framing in close collaboration with your vertical leadership.
 You will engage VP/SVP-level business leaders with credibility and rigour — bringing a blend of consultative problem-solving, AI knowledge, and hands-on experience delivering technology-driven outcomes.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Business stakeholder engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with VP/SVP-level business leaders within your sub-segment; understanding their priorities, pain points, and transformation opportunities
 Pipeline development: Identifying, sizing, and developing AI transformation opportunities within your sub-segment — contributing to a rigorous pipeline with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
 AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for business problems and supporting validation through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
 Business model & process re-engineering: Working with business stakeholders to rethink processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
 Program framing: Supporting business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing to ensure ideas translate into executable plans
 Delivery partnership: Working closely with our AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between transformation ambition and the technical execution path
 Cross-enterprise collaboration: Contributing to cross-vertical pattern recognition by surfacing reuse opportunities and horizontal themes observed within domain
 You're our ideal candidate if you: 
 Have 8–12 years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
 Have a track record of contributing to the delivery of AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by hands-on involvement in delivery outcomes
 Can engage VP/SVP-level business stakeholders with credibility — able to earn trust, challenge thinking, and drive alignment
 Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign , ideally enabled by technology or data
 Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
 Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
 Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
 Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required ; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries
 What's in it for you: 
 Drive AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with exposure to senior leadership across RBC
 Be part of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group alongside experienced transformation leaders
 A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
 Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
 Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale
 About the AI Group: 
 RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

 ·    Lead and support the development, maintenance and ongoing evolution of TDMS Credit Policy, ensuring policy remains current and aligned with risk appetite, business strategy, portfolio performance and regulatory expectations.

At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. Behavior Verification answers one question: is the driver's on-road behavior good enough to release, and how can we prove it even further? We are seeking a rigorous and decisive systems engineer to build the evidence behind that answer. You will define the scenario and test set content that various Software releases are measured against and that enable the development of new capabilities and features, establish the validity checks that keep those test sets trustworthy, and act as the gatekeeper for what enters the release pipeline. Your work directly informs whether autonomy software is promoted.
 
You will…
Design and document the scenario and test sets that establish on-road behavior performance, from minimum to comprehensive.
Own what enters the release pipeline: define and run the scenario validity checks, and approve or refuse test sets before they are used to judge a release.
Maintain continuous quality feedback of the artifacts test sets depend on — scenarios, taggers, graders and the taxonomy behind them.
Turn behavior requirements into testable criteria, working with Behavior Requirements on targets and acceptance criteria that someone will sign.
Investigate behavior deficiencies: find further instances, establish what exposure we have to them, and return them to the pipeline as test escapes.
Distinguish genuine behavior failures from simulation artifacts, and raise simulation fidelity gaps with the corresponding teams.
Work across the organization — motion planning, simulation, evaluation, operations, safety methodology and platform — and hold the interfaces between them.
Align verification phases and cadence with the organization: what runs on a daily release, and what a significant step in exposure requires.
 
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or related field (e.g., Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Advanced Controls, Aerospace, etc.).
Experience verifying safety-critical systems, ideallyin autonomous vehicles.
Demonstrated experience designing test cases from requirements, and assessing what a test set covers and what it misses.
Applied statistics: sample size, confidence, and what a result does and does not support.
Proficiency in Python and the ability to navigate a large codebase.
Familiarity with autonomous vehicle requirements, behaviors and design methodologies.
Strong ability to structure, document and prioritize a large number of test sets and test strategies.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a diplomatic way, across teams that do not always agree.
A drive for commitment and accountability, for yourself and for others.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
Trucking or heavy-vehicle exposure.
Machine learning experience, particularly model evaluation and false-positive / false-negative trade-offs.
Exposure to regulatory frameworks: NHTSA, ISO 26262, SOTIF.
Familiarity with the tooling required to extract coverage and exposure from large driving-log sets.
Comfortable working in a newly formed team, where the process has to be built rather than followed.

Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.

Trusted by over 30,000 locations across 32+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.

We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Device Management team.

This is an engineering role first: you'll design and build test automation frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that let the whole team ship confidently at speed. You'll write real code, against our Rust/Node.js APIs, our React front end, and our AWS serverless infrastructure, to make the system testable, simulate device behavior at scale, and catch problems before they reach customers. You'll work as a peer to developers, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews, and design decisions, with quality and testability as your lens.

You'll have significant latitude to shape how the team approaches testing, from framework design to CI/CD integration to how we simulate thousands of IoT devices and video streams in a repeatable, automated way.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Automation Framework & Tooling Development

 - Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and libraries spanning REST APIs, UI (React), security, and end-to-end/integration layers.

 - Write production-quality code for test harnesses, device simulators, performance tools and mocks that emulate IoT device behavior and video streams at scale.

 - Build and maintain tooling that improves testability across the stack — including for distributed, event-driven components (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Kinesis).

 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, optimizing for fast, reliable feedback on every build and deployment.

 - Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and approaches to keep test infrastructure scalable as the platform and team grow.

Engineering Collaboration & Architecture

 - Participate as a technical peer in design sessions, RFCs, and architecture discussions — advocating for testability, observability, and reliability from the start.

 - Review code and pull requests with an eye toward correctness, edge cases, performance, and long-term maintainability.

 - Work closely with backend and frontend engineers to understand system design and build automation that reflects real production behavior.

 - Contribute to system reliability by supporting monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting efforts, including issues involving device connectivity.

Test Strategy & Coverage

 - Design test plans and strategies for new and existing features, deciding where automation adds the most value versus targeted manual/exploratory testing.

 - Drive test coverage for IoT device configuration, monitoring, deployment, and connectivity workflows, as well as video playback, recording, and streaming features.

 - Validate distributed cloud systems for correctness, performance, and resilience under realistic and edge-case load.

 - Own test estimation and planning as part of sprint and release cycles, working directly with engineering leads.

Quality Leadership

 - Act as a proactive voice for quality across the engineering org — identifying systemic risks early and proposing engineering solutions (not just flagging bugs).

 - Mentor other engineers and QA team members on automation practices, framework usage, and testable design.

 - Provide direct, technically grounded feedback to developers and stakeholders when quality or architecture decisions are at risk.




WHAT YOU BRING

Must-Have:

 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong hands-on coding ability — this is a build-things role, not primarily a manual-execution role.

 - Strong programming skills in Python, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Rust, sufficient to build and maintain real test infrastructure and tooling.

 - Demonstrated experience designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up (API, UI, or integration layers), not just using existing ones.

 - Comfortable working in Linux environments.

 - Solid understanding of AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Kinesis, or similar) and how they underpin distributed, serverless SaaS applications.

 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and treating test infrastructure as a first-class engineering deliverable.

 - Ability to read and reason about production code, participate meaningfully in code reviews, and collaborate with developers as a technical peer.

 - Strong systems thinking — able to reason about distributed, event-driven, and resilience-focused architectures.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to give direct, technically substantiated feedback to developers and stakeholders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical/engineering experience.

Nice-to-Have:

 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (CDK, Terraform, Serverless Framework) for provisioning test environments.

 - Experience with IoT device communication protocols and building device simulators for test purposes.

 - Experience with video development, video streaming technologies, or testing video pipelines.

 - Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch).

 - Experience with Snowflake, Elasticsearch, or other cloud-native data platforms.

 - Contributions to open-source testing/automation tools, or strong personal projects demonstrating framework design skills.

 - Prior experience in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

 - Interest in eventually contributing to product code, or a background that blends SDET and full-stack development work.




SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

 - Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire.

 - Candidates will be required to attend at least one (1) in-person interview at the Ottawa office.

 - Must be a Canadian citizen (dual citizens included) or eligible to work in Canada.

 - Must be willing to comply with Solink's security policies and standards.

 - Mandatory onboarding in Ottawa during the first week of employment.

 - Periodic in-person visits required (quarterly basis) for non-Ottawa based employees




OUR VALUES

We do things the Solink way:

 - Act with URGENCY – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

 - Deliver with QUALITY – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

 - Win with TEAM – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

 - Lead with TRUST – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.
   

These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.




WHY SOLINK?

We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.

 - Clarity and trust: Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

 - Meaningful equity: Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

 - Comprehensive benefits: Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

 - Wellness support: Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

 - Growth through merit: Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

 - Candid culture: Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

 - Social connection: From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE HIRING PROCESS

We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:

 1. Intro call with our Talent Team

 2. Interview with the Hiring Manager

 3. Technical Panel Interview & cross-functional team members

 4. Final CTO Interview

 5. Reference Checks

 6. Offer & onboarding 🎉


PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AT ANY POINT IN THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS BASED ON THE NEEDS OF THE BUSINESS.




HOW TO APPLY

Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [Careers Page https://solink.com/careers/]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.


NOTICE: SOLINK USES ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) TO SCREEN, ASSESS, AND/OR SELECT CANDIDATES FOR THIS POSITION.




SOLINK IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. WE’RE COMMITTED TO BUILDING A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE. IF YOU REQUIRE ACCOMMODATION DURING THE SELECTION PROCESS, PLEASE LET US KNOW.

 Job Description 
 Division/Site Specific Information: 
 Our Whitby Site specializes in commercial manufacturing for a full range of conventional dosage forms with specialized capabilities, and houses a fully integrated pharmaceutical development services (PDS) facility.
 Discover Impactful Work: 
 The Senior Stationary Engineer provides senior-level technical expertise, operational support, and leadership for the safe, reliable, and compliant operation of the facility’s power plant, building systems, utilities, and associated equipment.
 The position is responsible for operating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing critical facility systems in accordance with Technical Standards and Safety Authority (TSSA) requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) standards, and site procedures.
 The Senior Stationary Engineer also serves as a technical resource to Stationary Engineers, maintenance personnel, contractors, Production, and other site stakeholders, providing guidance on complex equipment issues, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.
 Day in the Life: 
 Perform senior-level operational and maintenance duties for the facility's guarded power plant in accordance with applicable Ontario legislation, TSSA requirements, site procedures, and operating standards.
 Provide technical leadership and guidance to Stationary Engineers, maintenance personnel, and operations staff regarding the safe and reliable operation of power plant, utility, HVAC, and building systems.
 Operate, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot boilers, compressors, HVAC systems, pumps, dust collectors, air-handling equipment, and associated auxiliary equipment.
 Monitor and adjust environmental systems to maintain required temperature, relative humidity, differential pressure, and other controlled environmental parameters in accordance with GMP specifications and manufacturing requirements.
 Perform advanced troubleshooting of the Building Automation System (BAS) and associated controls, sensors, instrumentation, and mechanical systems related to environmental and facility performance.
 Diagnose equipment and system failures, identify root causes, and coordinate or perform appropriate corrective actions to minimize operational downtime.
 Repair, rebuild, modify, and install facility and utility equipment while ensuring work complies with applicable codes, engineering requirements, manufacturer specifications, and site procedures.
 Perform and oversee preventative and corrective maintenance on facility-related equipment in accordance with the site's Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) program.
 Operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain the Purified Water System, including completion and review of required operational logs and documentation.
 Perform required boiler-water testing, chemical monitoring, and associated documentation in accordance with applicable TSSA requirements and site operating procedures.
 Review equipment operating conditions, trends, alarms, and maintenance history to identify potential failures and opportunities to improve equipment reliability and performance.
 Provide technical support and training to operators and maintenance personnel on equipment operation, troubleshooting, safety, and maintenance practices.
 Work collaboratively with Group Leaders, Production Supervisors, Engineering, Quality, and Maintenance personnel to coordinate equipment downtime and ensure preventative maintenance is completed within established timeframes.
 Plan and coordinate maintenance activities to minimize disruption to manufacturing operations while ensuring equipment remains safe, reliable, and compliant.
 Maintain accurate and complete maintenance, operational, testing, and equipment records in accordance with GMP documentation requirements and site procedures.
 Provide technical input into equipment modifications, upgrades, commissioning activities, capital projects, and facility improvement initiatives.
 Participate in equipment commissioning, qualification, start-up, shutdown, and return-to-service activities as required.
 Lead or actively participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), deviation investigations, equipment failure investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and continuous improvement initiatives related to facility and utility systems.
 Participate in operational meetings, daily RAPIDs, maintenance planning meetings, EHS initiatives, and other cross-functional activities as required.
 Coordinate and oversee outside contractors performing maintenance, repairs, inspections, testing, and installation work on facility and utility equipment.
 Verify contractor work is completed safely and in accordance with site requirements, applicable regulations, permits, specifications, and established scope of work.

 Provide technical guidance during abnormal operating conditions, equipment failures, utility interruptions, and other facility-related emergencies.
 Perform alternating or rotating shift work as required and provide support during scheduled maintenance shutdowns, emergency repairs, and other operational requirements.

 High School Diploma or General Educational Development (GED) Certificate required.
 College diploma/certificate in Power Engineering, Stationary Engineering, Building Systems, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
 Valid Ontario Operating Engineer/Stationary Engineer certification appropriate to the classification and responsibilities of the plant, with a minimum 4th Class certification required.
 Higher-class Operating Engineer certification is considered an asset.
 Ontario Certificate of Qualification in an applicable skilled trade is considered an asset.
 Must maintain all licences, certificates, and qualifications required to perform assigned duties in accordance with applicable Ontario regulatory requirements.
 Experience: 
 Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in stationary engineering, power plant operations, utilities, facilities maintenance, or a related industrial environment, including significant experience operating and troubleshooting complex mechanical and building systems.
 Minimum 5 years of experience in a controlled, regulated, GMP, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food, chemical, or similarly regulated manufacturing environment is preferred.
 Demonstrated experience operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting boilers, HVAC systems, compressors, pumps, BAS controls, water systems, instrumentation, and associated facility equipment, including preventative maintenance, equipment reliability, and root cause investigations.
 Experience coordinating contractors, maintenance activities, shutdowns, and equipment downtime, while providing technical guidance, coaching, and training to operations and maintenance personnel.
 Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, mechanical and electrical drawings, equipment schematics, technical manuals, and specifications.
 Experience using CMMS for work orders, preventative maintenance, equipment history, and maintenance documentation.
 Maximo CMMS experience is preferred.
 Equivalency : 
 Equivalent combinations of education, training, and relevant work experience may be considered.
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
 Strong knowledge of stationary engineering and power plant operating practices applicable in Ontario, including safe operation of boilers, HVAC systems, compressed air systems, water systems, and associated facility utilities. Working knowledge of TSSA requirements and applicable Ontario regulations, codes, and standards, combined with a strong understanding of GMP requirements and documentation practices within a regulated manufacturing environment. Demonstrated advanced mechanical troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess equipment and system issues, determine appropriate corrective actions, and escalate critical issues when required. Strong organizational, maintenance planning, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple operational and maintenance requirements effectively. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, guidance, training, and mentorship while working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. Strong commitment to safety, quality, regulatory compliance, equipment reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

 Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 
 Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
 About the Team 
 Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.
 What You'll Do 
 As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

 Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience.
 Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses.
 Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems.
 Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers.
 Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. 
 Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users.
 Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work.
 Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback.
